device.metaphor: pure chart: one glowing candle, the buyers' stops popping under support, a sellers/buyers tug bar

scenes.vo: This candle lied to everyone who sold it. Watch what it did next.
Price had bounced off this level three times, so every buyer put their stop just under it.
Then one candle dipped below it, and all those stops were hit at once.
The sellers were done, the big buyers stepped in, and then it flew.
The dip under support was the entry, not the exit.
